name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell at arm's length, grip just outside the hips.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears — don't roll them.
Squeeze hard at the top for a full second.
Lower slowly to a dead hang. A power-shrug variant may use slight leg drive; keep the back flat.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: Barbell Shrug is a beginner pulling exercise for the upper back, performed with a barbell. Pulling balances all the pressing we do in life and keeps the upper back and posture strong.
